<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Elf Ranger](/NPCs.aspx?ID=2995)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Many elves learn the bow before even picking up their first blade. Because of this, many elves act as rangers at some point in their long lives.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47)): DC 15

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 13

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 10
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">
<image src="/images/Monsters/Elf_Ranger.webp" />
</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 1">[Elf Ranger](/NPCs.aspx?ID=2995)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Elf" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=588" />
<trait label="Humanoid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=628" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 151

**Perception** +10; [low-light vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=69)

**Languages**
[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Elven](/Languages.aspx?ID=4)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +7, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +3, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +3, [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) +6, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +7, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +6

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +1

**Dex** +4

**Con** +1

**Int** +3

**Wis** +3

**Cha** +1
</row>

**Items**
[Dagger](/Weapons.aspx?ID=3), [Shortbow](/Weapons.aspx?ID=77) (20 arrows)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 16 

**Fort** +4 

**Ref** +10 

**Will** +7 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 17

</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 30 feet; unimpeded journey

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
dagger +9 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [versatile S](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)),
**Damage** 1d4+2 piercing

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
shortbow +9 ([deadly d8](/Traits.aspx?ID=174), [range increment 60 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)),
**Damage** 1d6+2 piercing

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
dagger +9 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [thrown 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=195), [versatile S](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)),
**Damage** 1d4+2 piercing

**Double Shot** <actions string="Single Action" />  The elf ranger makes two shortbow Strikes targeting two different creatures within the shortbow's first range increment. Both Strikes uses the elf's current multiple attack penalty, but each strike takes a –2 penalty.

**Elf Step** <actions string="Single Action" />  The elf Steps twice.

**Unimpeded Journey**   The elf ranger ignores [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453).

</column>
